Waverley Prep School and Nursery, Wokingham - A Private, Co-Educational School
Ranked 'Best in Berkshire', 15th in the UK and National Athletics Champions 2026Waverley is a leading independent prep and pre-prep school and Nursery in Wokingham, Berkshire, and within easy reach of Arborfield Green, Crowthorne, Winnersh, Holme Meadows and surrounding areas. We provide an exceptional early years and primary school education for boys and girls from 3 mths to 11 yrs., combining outstanding academic achievement with extensive opportunities in sport, music and performing arts. Small class sizes, single-form entry (one class per year group) and a personalised education prepare pupils for entry to a superb range of selective Senior Schools (independent, grammar 11+ and state).
Exceptional Pass Rate for Selective Grammar and Independent Senior SchoolsPupils progress to an impressive range of secondary schools (grammar 11+, independent and state). 93% of 2026 Year 6 Leavers secured their first-choice school with a 97% pass rate for selective schools. More. Our average pass rate for the Grammar 11+ is 81% (2023-2026). More.
Academic Outcomes are Outstanding - Wokingham's Top Primary School95% of our 2026 Year 6 attained a combined score of 'Achieved & Greater Depth' in Reading, Writing & Maths SATS papers (compared to the national average of 62%). More.

A Happy, Family-Feel School with a Broad, Rich CurriculumNurturing happy, confident children who embrace opportunities and strive for excellence. One class per year group with an average of 21 pupils. More
Senior School Scholarship Success86% of 2026 Leavers received multiple senior school offers. 47% secured at least one scholarship across academics, sport and the performing arts. More
Inspected as 'Double Excellent'... in our most recent graded inspection (2022). Waverley also achieved 100% compliance in its latest 2024 inspection. Our Nursery is inspected as 'Outstanding', reflecting our commitment to excellence from the very earliest years. These are the highest possible gradings achievable. More

Easy Steps to Secure Your School Place...
If you are interested in your child attending Waverley Prep School, there are 3 simple steps.
1. Apply (No fee). Visit our our Admissions portal here and complete an Application Form or email our Admissions Team here.
2. Join us for a 1-2-1 Tour. Upon receipt of an Application Form, if we have a place available, we invite parents to a 1-2-1 tour.
3. Meet our Head.Following a tour, the family will be invited to meet our Head on a mutually convenient day.
4. Taster Day.Prospective pupils are invited to spend a Taster Day with us to ensure they will feel happy and settled they can flourish in our school.
5. Accept an Offer. Our Admissions Committee considers all applications and allocates our places. We normally have a 10-14 window to accept a school place.

Secondary School Scholarship Successes 2026
Further to 93% of our pupils being awarded a place at their first choice Senior School, Waverley is absolutely thrilled that almost half our Year 6 pupils of 2026 were awarded at least one Secondary School scholarship (47%).
Congratulations to Rebecca, Ellen, Mikey, William, Sienna, Toby and Aurelia, who have all received scholarship offers from a range of senior schools including Luckley, The Abbey, Farnborough Hill and Crosfields School.
Mikey and Aurelia are celebrating sports scholarship offers while Rebecca, Toby, Ellen, William and Sienna have been awarded academic scholarships. A special mention goes to Ellen, who has made history by being the first Waverley pupil to be awarded an academic scholarship from Reading Blue Coat School. Likewise, well done to our Head Boy, Toby, who received academic scholarships from both his preferred senior schools.
All of our scholarship pupils have worked extremely hard to achieve these awards and we are proud that these results celebrate not only the academic talents of Waverley pupils but also their sporting prowess. The results celebrate what incredible multi-talented young people our Year 6 pupils are growing up to be. We wish them all every success as they move on to their Senior Schools this September.

pageCache.text:
Speech & Drama
"The communication skills exhibited by pupils are outstanding. Pupils are extremely articulate and able to express their thoughts and feelings very well." ISI
The Benefits of Speech and Drama Classes:
Speech and Drama at Waverley is an ideal way to build your child’s self-confidence. Speech and Drama classes help children to express themselves, think outside the box and engage with the other children. Our classes are split into small groups allowing the children to build their confidence. The children have the opportunity to use their imagination and be led to express this through their bodies and movement.
The children participate in vocal activities and games, which help to build listening and attention skills, as the children follow instructions and respond when asked. The children also learn tongue twisters which help to improve communication & language and pronunciation, as they use repetition and take turns reciting these.
Lessons will help your child build up their vocabulary and communicate their thoughts to help improve their ability to ask questions, which is important for their learning. It can also play a supporting role for speech delays or impediments, by learning about voice projection and correct pronunciation, which then helps a child to be more confident when using communication and language.
Speech and Drama is one of a range of extra-curricular classes taught by specialist tutors (Peripatetic classes) to enable children to broaden their love of a chosen activity. With this class, pupils are also given the chance to work towards graded exams with many children choosing to work towards a Trinity College Speech and Drama examination each year.

pageCache.text:
The Arts and Music
Whilst academic success is at the heart of our aim for every child, we also seek to nurture talents outside of the core curriculum including The Arts, Music, performing and Speech & Drama. All children take part in school choir assemblies and many children learn to play an instrument in the school, or work towards examinations in Speech and Drama.
Every child is encouraged to enjoy and take part in our energetic and vibrant music activities. We also offer a range of extra-curricular classes taught by specialist tutors (Peripatetic classes) to enable children to broaden their love of a chosen activity including a musical instrument or Speech and Drama - pupils are also given the chance to work towards graded exams. There is an additional charge for Peripatetic classes with the exception of Choir. For more information on booking and charges, please contact our Co-curricular Co-ordinator Mrs Pippa Eden, by emailing pippa.eden@waverleyschool.co.uk
Every child also takes an active part in their class assembly, as well as annual Christmas and Summer productions and the House Music Competition. These performances give children a chance to shine and for parents to see their child’s confidence growing year on year, bringing the whole school community together to celebrate their children’s talents.
Creativity and Expression Through Art
Children are encouraged to explore and build their skills in Art, Textiles and Design & Technology (DT). Children's art, models and projects are proudly displayed throughout our school to celebrate our pupils' achievements.
Concerts in the Community
Throughout the academic year, Waverley pupils also give outstanding musical productions, poetry and choral recitals, and drama presentations in a number of local, regional and national performances. These include the Woodley Festival and the Wellington College Crowthorne Carnival.
Many children also choose to work towards a Trinity College Speech and Drama examination each year.
Such achievements develop a child's self-confidence, self-esteem and presentation skills - an important lifeskill which helps a child grow and mature as a confident individual.
All peripatetic music lessons and clubs are subject to half a term’s notice, in writing, if your child would like to stop participating.

Curriculum
At Waverley we offer an enhanced curriculum, which is tailored to each child’s individual need.
We aim to enable every child to achieve his or her full potential and to thrive in an ethos of support, while being challenged and encouraged to succeed.
Our bespoke facilities enable our curriculum to be delivered innovatively and effectively, making Waverley an exciting place to learn. We have a networked ICT suite with touch screens, a library, a Science, DT and Art room, music rooms, home economic facilities, two halls and a playing field.
In the Preparatory Department children are taught by specialist teachers in Art, Games, ICT, Music, Science and French. Swimming lessons are taught weekly from Year 1 to Year 6.
From Year 5 we offer additional classes for 11+ and scholarship candidates.

pageCache.pageTitle: Waverley Independent Private Prep (Primary) School - Wokingham, Berkshire - Reception Admissions 2027
pageCache.text:
Reception 2027 Places at Waverley Prep School in Wokingham
Looking for a Reception school place for September 2027? Ranked 'Best in Berkshire' and 15th in the UK, Waverley is an independent, co-educational Prep and Pre-Prep School in Wokingham, Berkshire, offering an exceptional education for boys and girls from 3 months to 11 years.
Our Reception class provides a nurturing, stimulating start to school life, combining excellent academic foundations with outstanding opportunities in sport, music, performing arts and the wider curriculum. With small class sizes and single-form entry, every child receives the individual attention and encouragement they need to thrive.
Reception places for September 2027 are now available for children aged 4-5 years at our top ranking school. We welcome prospective parents to visit Waverley for a 1-2-1 tour, meet our team and discover what makes our school special. Our Reception 2027 class is open to children born between 1st September 2022 and 31st August 2023.
Email our Admissions Team
Why Choose Waverley for Reception?
A Personalised Education: Small classes with an average of 21 pupils per class, single-form entry (one class per year group) and maximum 1:10 teaching ratio mean that every child is known as an individual.
Excellent Academic Foundations: Our school is ranked Best in Berkshire and 15th in the UK based on the SATS results of our Year 6 pupils. Waverley offers an excellent pathway to a range of renowned secondary schools by giving children the very best foundations to their education. We offer tailored preparation for entry into senior schools including 11+ grammar (Reading Boys and Kendrick Girls Grammar in Reading), selective independent schools including Reading Blue Coat, Wellington College, Bradfield College and many more, as well as state secondary schools.
A Love of Learning! Our Reception class is learning through play, supported by a solid, accelerated foundation in reading, writing and numbers. These daily specialist sessions are taught in very small groups (3-4 children per teacher), with children of similar ability, to provide individually tailored teaching for each child.
Outstanding Opportunities Beyond the Classroom: Children thrive with our wealth of sport, music, performing arts, art, and Forest School which are all included in the curriculum. We also offer a vibrant After School Club with over 75 different activities to choose from every academic year.
A Nurturing Environment: Our small, family-friendly school welcomes families and children from all backgrounds. We know every child and what makes them tick so they can achieve their full potential.
Our Reception Facilities: Constructed in 2026, our dedicated state-of-the-art Reception classroom facility consists of modern teaching, bright airy spaces with air-conditioning. The Reception facility also has its own outdoor learning-through-play area which adjoins the larger main school playground. The unit is self-contained with its own toilet, has an indoor air quality monitoring system and is equipped with toys and learning equipment specifically for young children starting school.
Not Just Academics! Every child has a talent and we will find it! We are currently National Athletics Champions 2026! We offer outstanding opportunities not only in academics but also sports, art and the performing arts. This includes competing in weekly sports fixtures, national tournaments, choral and poetry competitions and ISA Art competitions.
Conveniently Located in Wokingham

Welcome to Waverley Prep School Wokingham
Welcome to Waverley, a leading independent Prep and Pre-Prep School in Wokingham, Berkshire, where children from 3 months to 11 years are encouraged to be happy, confident and ambitious.
Choosing the right school for your child is one of the most important decisions you will make as a parent. At Waverley, we believe children thrive when they feel known, valued and supported.
Located in Finchampstead, Wokingham, our co-educational school combines a warm, nurturing environment with an ambitious approach to learning. Our small classes and single-form entry mean that every child is known as an individual, allowing our teachers to understand their strengths, interests and areas for development.
We want every child to enjoy coming to school, develop a lifelong love of learning and have the confidence to discover what they can achieve.
We would love you to come and experience Waverley for yourself.
A Happy, Nurturing School
We believe that happy children make the best learners.
Waverley has a close-knit, family feel where children know and support one another and teachers know every pupil as an individual. Our nurturing environment gives children the confidence to try new things, make friends, challenge themselves and learn from their experiences.
Our aim is for every child to feel that they belong, are valued and can be themselves.
The Waverley Way – We Are Kind. We Are Honest. We Do Our Best. – is at the heart of our school community. We encourage pupils to be kind, courageous and curious, while taking pride in their achievements and always striving to do their best.
A Personalised Education for Every Child
With one class per year group and an average class size of around 21 pupils, Waverley provides a genuinely personalised education.
Our teachers know their pupils exceptionally well and can provide both support and challenge according to individual needs. From the earliest years in Nursery through to Year 6, we aim to develop confident, independent learners who are ready to embrace every opportunity.
Our broad curriculum combines strong academic foundations with opportunities in sport, music, art, drama, performing arts, outdoor learning and Forest School.
We believe that every child has something special to offer. Our role is to help them discover what that is.
Discover why families choose Waverley
Outstanding Academic Achievement
We have high academic expectations and are committed to helping every child achieve their potential.
Our 2026 Year 6 results were excellent, with 95% of pupils achieving the combined Expected Standard or Greater Depth in Reading, Writing and Maths, compared with a national average of 62%. In Maths, 100% of pupils met the accepted standard, compared with a national average of 73%.
Waverley is currently ranked 15th in the UK, based on Year 6 SATs results, and has been recognised as 'Best in Berkshire' for 14 consecutive years.
However, we believe academic success is about more than results. We want children to become curious, resilient and enthusiastic learners who are well prepared for the next stage of their education.
Explore our rankings
Explore our SATS results
Opportunities Beyond the Classroom
Education at Waverley extends far beyond the classroom.
Our pupils have opportunities to develop their talents and interests across sport, music, art, drama and performing arts, alongside clubs, trips and outdoor learning.
We are particularly proud of our sporting achievements. In 2026, Waverley pupils became National Athletics Champions, winning gold in the headline 4 x 100m relay at the ISA National Athletics Championships.
Whether a child is passionate about sport, fascinated by science, loves performing, enjoys creating art or simply wants to try something new, we encourage them to embrace opportunities and discover what they can achieve.
Discover sport at Waverley
Discover the Arts and Music at Waverley
Preparing Children for their Next School
Our responsibility does not end when pupils leave Waverley. We want every child to move on to the secondary school that is right for them.
Our 2026 Year 6 leavers secured places at an impressive range of independent, grammar and state secondary schools. 93% secured their first-choice secondary school, while 47% received at least one scholarship offer across academics, sport, music and the performing arts. The selective-school pass rate was 97%.
We work closely with families throughout the senior-school process, helping each child identify and pursue the opportunities that best match their individual strengths, interests and aspirations.
Explore Secondary School Destinations of Year 6
Explore our Secondary School Scholarships
From Nursery to Year 6
Waverley offers a continuous educational journey from 3 months to 11 years, with Nursery, Pre-Prep and Prep School provision on one site.
This provides children with continuity and familiarity as they grow, while giving them increasing opportunities to develop their independence, confidence and skills.
For busy families, Waverley also offers wrap-around care through our Breakfast Club, After School Club and Holiday Club. Our in-house clubs provide care from 7.30am to 6.00pm, 51 weeks of the year.
Discover Waverley Nursery
A School Where Every Child Can Thrive
At Waverley, we want children to leave us at eleven with more than excellent academic results.
We want them to be confident, kind, resilient and curious. We want them to know their strengths, understand the value of hard work and have the confidence to embrace whatever comes next.
Above all, we want them to look back on their years at Waverley with happy memories, strong friendships and a genuine love of learning.
An Independent School Near Holme Meadows and Arborfield Green
Waverley is conveniently located and within easy driving distance of the new communities of Holme Meadows in Wokingham and Arborfield Green. With the new South Wokingham Distributor Road (bypass) almost complete and the final section to Tesco nearing completion, access to Waverley will be even quicker and easier.
Moving to Holme Meadows? Explore more
Moving to Arborfield Green? Explore more
Come and Experience Waverley
Choosing a school is a very personal decision, and we believe the best way to discover Waverley is to visit us.
We warmly invite prospective families to arrange a personal 1-to-1 tour, meet our teachers, see our pupils in action and experience the warm, welcoming atmosphere of our school.
Could Waverley be the right school for your child? Come and find out.

pageCache.pageTitle: Waverley Independent Private Prep (Primary) School - Wokingham, Berkshire - Why Choose Waverley Prep School
pageCache.text:
10 Reasons to Choose Waverley Prep School - Wokingham's Leading Independent School
Waverley Prep and Pre-Prep in Wokingham, Berkshire, offers an exceptional education for boys and girls from 3 months to 11 years. From our Nursery through to Year 6, we provide a nurturing and inspiring environment where every child is known, valued, celebrated and encouraged to achieve their very best. .
1. Our Ranking
Ranked 15th in the UK by The Times and 'Best in Berkshire’ for the last 14 years based on Waverley's academic results out of over 20,000 Prep and State Primary Schools. Read more here about our rankings.
2. An impressive range of Secondary School offers
Pupils from Waverley achieve places at a range of local and nationally renowned Secondary Schools, including Wellington College, Reading Blue Coat, Bradfield College, Reading Boys Grammar, Kendrick Girls Grammar in Reading, and many more. We pride ourselves that our most recent Year 6 of 2026 achieved a pass rate of 97% for selective secondary schools (grammar 11+ and independent) and 93% of our Year 6 leavers of 2026 were offered a places at their first choice secondary school. Read more.
Many pupils also achieve scholarships to their preferred school for a range of academic, art, music and sports talents. Almost half (47%) of our 2026 Year 6 pupils were awarded at least one secondary school scholarship for their talents in academics, sports, drama, music and performing arts. Read more.
3. Impressive 2026 SATS results. 100% of pupils met the accepted Maths standard compared to 73% national average
Furthermore, 95% of our pupils obtained a combined (Reading, Writing and Maths) score of 'Achieved and Greater Depth' compared to a national average of 62%. Read more.
4. A personalised education for every child
Our curriculum includes all children receiving 50 minutes per day of high-quality phonics and reading tuition in groups of 4 pupils per teacher via our Read Write Inc system. Children at Waverley excel academically but also flourish in sports, art, music and drama. Our children develop a life-long love of learning, supported by dedicated teachers who know every child as an individual.
5. Top Marks in our ISI Inspection and an 'Outstanding' Nursery
Waverley is consistently inspected as an excellent school. Our Prep School was rated 'Double Excellent' in all areas of our inspection (February 2022) by the Independent Schools Inspectorate (ISI) and then achieved 100% compliance and 'Top Marks' in our most recent ISI inspection in February 2024. These are the highest possible gradings achievable. Our Nursery was inspected as 'Outstanding' in our 2024 inspection. Read more.
6. Sporting prowess - National Athletics Champions 2026
Waverley Prep School is a family-friendly, nurturing environment where children excel academically but also flourish in sports, art, music and drama due to our broad curriculum. We are thrilled to be the current UK champions having won Gold in the headline event at the ISA (Independent Schools Association) National Athletics Championships at the Alexander Stadium in Birmingham. Read more.
We pride ourselves in spotting sporting talent and encourage pupils to join a dedicated club if appropriate. Recent leavers include a sports scholar who has achieved a place at an Ivy League University in the USA.
7. A parent-friendly fee structure
8. Small class sizes in a warm, nurturing environment with a family feel
9. An education combining traditional and modern teaching methods
10. Average 76% pass rate for 11+ (Grammar school)
And finally...! Wrap-around care 51 weeks per year, from 07:30hrs - 18:00hrs every weekday

pageCache.pageTitle: Waverley Independent Private Prep (Primary) School - Wokingham, Berkshire - Day Trips & Residentials
pageCache.text:
Day trips and Residentials
Adventures Beyond the Classroom
At Waverley we are keen to offer our pupils life-enriching opportunities to develop their skills, confidence and understanding beyond the school curriculum. These activities are a key factor in their learning journey.
Performing In The Wider Community
Throughout the Prep School (Year 3 onwards) children are actively encouraged to take part in a wide variety of competitions and community events. These include sports fixtures, maths challenges, choir competitions and poetry recitals against other local schools. Waverley pupils have recently given outstanding performances at the Woodley Festival and Wellington College Maths Challenge.
Every year group at Waverley, from Reception onwards, enjoys regular school trips. These have included visits to Kew Gardens, the Science Museum, Hampton Court Palace, Windsor Castle and the Natural History Museum. Our school trips are carefully planned to offer a balance of age-appropriate cultural, artistic and historical activities.
STEAMFest 2023 25th May 2023 25 images
Windsor Castle Trip 10th Feb 2023 64 images
The Living Rainforest Trip 10th Feb 2023 46 images
Roald Dahl Museum Trip 8th Feb 2023 77 images
In Key Stage 2 (Year 3 onwards), all pupils at Waverley are encouraged to participate in our residential trips. Combining adventure and fun, the residential trips offer inspirational outdoor learning. Pupils have the freedom to discover, learn and explore about themselves and the wider world in a safe, stimulating environment. Waverley pupils always return home more confident, a little more independent and with wonderful memories!
Year 5 & 6 Residential 29th Jun 2023 281 images
Year 3 & 4 PGL 28th Apr 2023 57 images
